store.summary: A standalone SoundCloud player for Cardputer Zero
store.description: A dark, orange-accented 320x170 on-device player with physical-key controls, public SoundCloud Widget playback, local queue, saved library and user-created playlists. No phone companion is required. The QtWebKit browser engine is a runtime dependency.
